question: Should request-stage SSRF interception become the uniform contract for all navigation-capable Playwright interactions before this PR merges?
rationale: The patch proves the mechanism for three actions but leaves common sibling actions behind the weaker post-dispatch boundary, so permanent security scope requires owner intent.

options.title: Complete the invariant
options.body: Extend the page-scoped request guard to click, submit/type, press, coordinate click, select, and fill before merge.

options.title: Accept bounded coverage
options.body: Land only the three-action repair after a security owner explicitly accepts and canonically tracks the remaining pre-dispatch gaps.

recommendation.title: Complete the invariant
recommendation.body: Extend the page-scoped request guard to click, submit/type, press, coordinate click, select, and fill before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current browser plugin ownership boundary and have the deepest central-file history among the identified candidates.
